name: AI VIP站
tagline: Top up ChatGPT Plus / Pro with Alipay or WeChat Pay
description: AI VIP Zhan is an independent third-party service that helps users in China activate ChatGPT Plus and Pro subscriptions, Codex credits, and Gemini and Claude memberships, paying in RMB with Alipay or WeChat Pay instead of a foreign credit card. Orders are delivered automatically, usually within 30 seconds to 3 minutes, and each plan states clearly what is and isn't covered. It also publishes Chinese guides on signing up for ChatGPT, choosing between Plus and Pro, and fixing top-up problems. Not affiliated with OpenAI, Google or Anthropic.
